description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the BuzzService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests that the BuzzService correctly provides instances of BuzzDao and BuzzLikeDao.

classes.name: BuzzServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of BuzzService related to DAO retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BuzzService before each test.

methods.name: testGetBuzzDao
methods.description: Asserts that getBuzzDao returns an instance of BuzzDao.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Asserts that getBuzzLikeDao returns an instance of BuzzLikeDao.
